'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Montserratian general election]]
**Residents of [[Montserrat]] vote to elect nine of the eleven members of the [[Legislative Assembly of Montserrat|Legislative Assembly]] under [[plurality block voting]]. [https://caribbean.loopnews.com/content/montserratians-voting-new-government-today (Loop News)]
**Former [[Premier of Montserrat]] [[Reuben Meade]] and his newly established party [[United Alliance (Montserrat)|United Alliance]] wins five seats in the general election, establishing a majority and the ability to form a new government. The [[People's Democratic Movement (Montserrat)|People's Democratic Movement]] party wins three seats and the [[Movement for Change and Prosperity]] party wins one seat. [https://www.stvincenttimes.com/reuben-meade-returns-as-premier-of-montserrat-after-general-election/ (''St. Vincent Times'')] [https://caribbean.loopnews.com/content/montserrat-former-premier-returns-victory-general-election (Loop News)]
*The [[European Parliament]] awards the [[Sakharov Prize]] to [[Venezuela]]n opposition leaders [[María Corina Machado]] and [[Edmundo González]] for their activism. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuelan-opposition-leaders-machado-gonzales-awarded-sakharov-prize-2024-10-24/ (Reuters)]
